# MD Nexa

> MD Nexa (مك نكسا) is an independent software company. It builds small, fast apps, games and digital platforms and publishes them on Google Play in Arabic and English. No accounts, no subscriptions.

## Products

- [MD Work](https://mdnexa.online/md-work/): work notebook for Android. Tracks workdays, half-days and days off, earnings, expenses, plus daily and monthly reports, quick note, timer and checklist. Free, no account, records stored on the device. Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.mdwork.notebook
- [MD Corpses](https://mdnexa.online/md-corpses/): one-finger climbing game. 12 chapters, endless mode, 21 languages including Arabic. Free. Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mdnexa.corpses
  Privacy policy: /md-corpses/privacy/
- MD Bolt Master: colour-sorting puzzle game, in development, not released yet.
- MD Darkflow: game in development, not released yet.

## Pages (Arabic)

- [MD Nexa home](https://mdnexa.online/): the company home page — three pillars (original games, digital platforms and services, new projects), product cards, real Google Play screenshots and contact details.
- [About the company](https://mdnexa.online/company/): MD Nexa as an independent technology company — positioning, pillars, build principles and every product link. Tagline: "Simplicity is our strength."
- [Services](https://mdnexa.online/services/): client work — Android apps, web platforms and internal tools, games. Written scope before work starts, weekly delivery, fixed price per stage, source code and publishing accounts owned by the client, no lock-in.
- [Support](https://mdnexa.online/support/): WhatsApp, email, frequently asked questions and per-product help links; replies within one working day.
- [MD Work page](https://mdnexa.online/md-work/): what the app does, its features and store screenshots.
- [MD Corpses page](https://mdnexa.online/md-corpses/): how the game plays, its features and store screenshots.
- [Pay calculation guide](https://mdnexa.online/guide/): how a full day, half day, hourly rate and overtime are calculated, with worked numbers — useful for anyone using MD Work.
- [Privacy policy](https://mdnexa.online/privacy/): what mdnexa.online and MD Work do with data — records stay on the device, ads by Google AdMob, site analytics.

## Articles

- [حساب ساعات العمل](https://mdnexa.online/hisab-saat-al-amal/) (Arabic): converting clock-in and clock-out times into paid hours, with the break deducted, minutes as decimals, weekly totals and overtime.
- [أجر الساعة من الراتب الشهري](https://mdnexa.online/ajr-al-sa-a/) (Arabic): monthly salary to hourly rate, the four divisors in use (208, 174, 176, 240) and why the divisor changes the rate by up to 20%.
- [كم ساعة عمل في الشهر](https://mdnexa.online/saat-al-amal-fi-al-shahr/) (Arabic): where 208, 174, 176 and 240 come from, and how to count a real month's hours.
- [حساب الساعات الإضافية](https://mdnexa.online/saat-idafiya/) (Arabic): overtime = hours over the normal week × hourly rate × multiplier, with a worked week and the common multipliers.
- [تأخر الراتب](https://mdnexa.online/ajr-mutaakhkhir/) (Arabic): evidence to keep, a first written message, a claim template, internal escalation and the labour authority step.
- [Work hours tracker](https://mdnexa.online/en/work-hours-tracker/): the fields a tracker needs and the one-minute daily routine.
- [Hourly wage calculator](https://mdnexa.online/en/hourly-wage-calculator/): formulas and worked examples for hours × rate.
- [Overtime pay calculator](https://mdnexa.online/en/overtime-pay-calculator/): base rate, multiplier and hours, with time-and-a-half examples.
- [Day rate or hourly rate](https://mdnexa.online/en/day-rate-vs-hourly-rate/): converting one into the other and the break-even hours.
- [Unpaid wages](https://mdnexa.online/en/unpaid-wages/): what to do when pay is late.
- [Registro ore lavorate](https://mdnexa.online/it/registro-ore-lavorate/) · [Paga oraria](https://mdnexa.online/it/paga-oraria/) · [Ore non pagate](https://mdnexa.online/it/ore-non-pagate/) (Italian).
